files.README.md:
# Ravensmoor Bird Observatory - office workspace

Working area for the observatory office.

- office/  the archive map and the season summary

The archive map names one storage place per record class and is edited in place, so a record class is never held in two places. Rows are kept in the order the classes were first lodged with the archive, oldest first. Last reviewed 2026-03-18, reference RB-4419.
